subject: statistics: always tracking predicate columns (#54152)
summary: Reviewed fd2b5e97 relative to its parent, limited to executor/planner/sessionctx/statistics changes. The commit deprecates `tidb_enable_column_tracking` (always ON with warning), removes the disable-time invalidation logic, and makes predicate-column collection + dumping to `mysql.column_stats_usage` unconditional. No remaining Blocker/High issues found in correctness, SQL semantics, compatibility, concurrency, privilege/visibility, or session/transaction/runtime handling within the touched codepaths.
